result:
Unit 426 is complete, all four tasks with nothing dropped, and every commit pushed (last one 77926ee6). output.md is written. The preamp now follows the overload after the tune-in. I left 7.8 unticked because of one leftover sentence about the attenuator.

**What changed for the operator.** If the band starts overloading after he has tuned into a CW block:
- **Off:** once the overload has held for about 1 second (4 polls), Hamlet turns the preamp off itself and says so on the status line.
- **Back on:** once it has been clear for about 5 seconds, Hamlet puts back the band's setting (preamp 1 on HF, preamp 2 on 6 m). If the overload returns right after that, the preamp stays off until his next tune-in.
- **His hand wins:** if he sets the preamp himself, Hamlet leaves it until his next tune-in and tells him so.
- **Never while transmitting:** nothing is written while the radio is transmitting, or while it won't say whether it is.
- **Only in blocks that set the preamp:** in a block that doesn't state the preamp, nothing is followed.

The hold times come from a measured poll every 252.9 ms against the test radio, plus an estimated 14 ms of wire time on the real radio. There's no radio on this machine to measure that part.

**The counts:**
- Preamp writes on an overload after the tune-in at 7.030 MHz: 0 ΓåÆ 1.
- Sentences asking him to change one of the nine fields Hamlet set: 60 ΓåÆ 12. Where the tuned block still sets the field, it was 0 and stays 0.
- The trace found that Receive Help told him to open a receive gain that was already full, calling it "about 39 percent". It compared a percent reading against a 0ΓÇô255 threshold. That's fixed.

**Why 7.8 isn't ticked.** The 12 remaining sentences are all one true line. After he moves into a block that doesn't set the front end, with the preamp now off, the overload sentence tells him the attenuator is the next thing to try. The only ways to remove it are following the attenuator live, which the new ruling forbids, or silencing a true sentence, which R74 forbids. Whether 7.8 covers only the fields the current block sets is your call; I parked it as P27.
